# TileLang kernel definition
@T.prim_func
def mse_kernel(
    predictions: T.handle,
    targets: T.handle,
    output: T.handle,
    batch_size: T.int32,
    dim: T.int32,
):
    T.func_attr({"global_symbol": "mse_kernel", "tir.noalias": True})
    
    # Handle declarations
    P = T.match_buffer(predictions, [batch_size, dim], dtype="float16")
    T = T.match_buffer(targets, [batch_size, dim], dtype="float16")
    O = T.match_buffer(output, [1], dtype="float32")
    
    # Shared memory for reduction
    shared_buf = T.alloc_buffer([32768], dtype="float32", scope="shared")
    
    # Thread-level reduction
    tid = T.thread_binding(0, 32768, "threadIdx.x")
    local_sum = T.allocate([1], dtype="float32", scope="local")
    
    # Initialize local sum
    local_sum[0] = T.float32(0.0)
    
    # Compute squared differences
    if tid < batch_size * dim:
        row = tid // dim
        col = tid % dim
        
        diff = P[row, col] - T[row, col]
        squared_diff = diff * diff
        local_sum[0] += T.cast(squared_diff, "float32")
    
    # Store in shared memory
    shared_buf[tid] = local_sum[0]
    
    # Synchronize threads
    T.evaluate(T.tvm_thread_allreduce(T.kAvg, shared_buf[tid], 32768, 0, 0))
    
    # Write result to output
    if tid == 0:
        O[0] = shared_buf[0]
